rationale: The agent did not confirm the change with the user before modifying the order, which violates policy. It also changed the boots to size 9, while the user requested size 8—an incorrect action. The agent selected leather waterproof despite the user stating they didn’t care about waterproofing, and it did not clarify the intended material choice. Authentication was not clearly established beyond name/ZIP. Finally, it asserted a refund to PayPal without explicit evidence from tool outputs. Therefore, the request was not completed correctly or per policy.
